name: Hindalco Industries
about: Hindalco Industries Ltd., the metals flagship of the Aditya Birla Group, is a global leader in aluminium and copper, with operations spanning 50 manufacturing units in 10 countries. It produces a wide range of aluminium products, including ingots, billets, wire rods, and foils, along with copper cathodes, continuous cast rods, and fertilizers. Hindalco’s subsidiary, Novelis Inc., is the world’s largest producer of flat-rolled aluminium products and the largest recycler of used beverage cans. In India, it operates integrated aluminium facilities, from mining to downstream products, and one of Asia’s largest copper smelters. Hindalco champions sustainability with a focus on innovative, eco-friendly solutions.
